تستمطرين (form X)
# تَسْتَمْطِرِينَ (tastamṭirīna) /tas.tam.tˤi.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
# تُسْتَمْطَرِينَ (tustamṭarīna) /tus.tam.tˤa.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
